mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, event_type, entity_type, entity_id, operator_id, operator_name, action, before_data, after_data, ip_address, user_agent, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_audit_event ( id, tenant_id, event_type, entity_type, entity_id, operator_id, operator_name, action, before_data, after_data, ip_address, user_agent, create_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{eventType}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{action}, #{beforeData}, #{afterData}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_audit_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM crm_audit_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND operator_id = #{operatorId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
